content.note: Read the promise of mercy in 39:53 together with the call to repent and submit in 39:54. Do not describe Islam as lacking divine mercy.

reviews.note: Read the linked Quran.com primary passage in the Mustafa Khattab translation on 2026-10-09. Checked verse locator, surrounding context and documentary role. Wording is paraphrased; no human theological approval is claimed.
